purpose: Finite exploratory vendor-reliance accounting/strategy diagnostic; not investment acceptance or replacement of the broad study
universe_selection: Previously collected engineering cases; JPM parked for unresolved evidence, not ranked by returns; survivor/convenience bias disclosed

strategy.holding_policy: Existing continuation_30: reviews 30,35,40,45,50,55,60,90,120,...; retain only with fresh prior-20-session high, positive estimated net sale profit, stock/SPY above EMA200; no hard maximum
strategy.risk_settings_role: Frozen old research controls; not personal paper-risk approval and not a guarantee of 5% maximum loss
strategy.fill_timing: Next actual session open after a completed-close signal; ordinary stop conventions retained

cash_scenarios: First actual open strictly after issuer payable New York date
Five further exchange-session opens after base
No credit within evaluation window; earned rights remain outstanding
run_count_formula: 1 strategy x 2 windows x 2 account sizes x 2 costs x 3 cash scenarios

proposed_assumptions.vendor_reliance: Explicitly accept provider AAPL ex-dates, stable ticker/identity mappings and limited action inventory as exploratory inputs with independent-review gaps retained; not certified complete histories
proposed_assumptions.identity: Issuer common-share/fund anchors and CBRE documented alias continuity; do not treat unresolved historical tax subtype as false or use a REIT filter
proposed_assumptions.known_at: Second actual session open after date-only Apple declaration; block if this is later than required boundary. CBRE rename uses dated filing; split uses July 30 2020 issuer release.
proposed_assumptions.entitlement: Model ordinary Apple dividends for held whole shares at the provider ex-date; no verified broker entitlement claim, no unreviewed special/due-bill/fractional events
proposed_assumptions.cash: Three declared scenarios; issuer payable is not actual broker availability
proposed_assumptions.economic_rights: Nominal fixed USD receivables separately reported; do not call unpaid rights settled cash or fully liquidated profit
proposed_assumptions.features: Raw dividend gaps; effective split rebasing only once effective; raw SPY price-only EMA context without cash/dividend inputs
proposed_assumptions.spy_passive_total_return: Not produced; no zero-filling gain blanks or selecting a precision policy needed for context-only use

implementation_required: Separate versioned diagnostic mode and assumption journal; preserve strict ownership/evidence flags
Derive reviewed input schedule from pinned event matrix and calendar, without modifying originals
Verify split share/feature/stop handling, cash rights, duplicate protection, delays, alias boundary and ledger reconciliation before performance runs
Stop all runs on contradictory dates/terms, calendar gaps, unexpected action kinds, unavailable required knowledge bounds or failed accounting checks
diagnostics: Net marked portfolio return and CAGR; separately estimate final sale costs
Realized P&L, open holdings, unpaid rights and spendable cash reported separately
Closing drawdown, daily-OHLC risk bounds, loss halts, fees, slippage and spread
Trade count, holding durations, per-stock contribution, exposure and idle cash
All 24 results retained; no choosing a cash scenario, rule, dates or replacement stock for its return

acceptance.reason: Only two traded stocks and unclosed evidence assumptions; report exploratory outcomes without acceptance claims

approval.request_text: Approve the limited AAPL/CBRE diagnostic and its listed vendor/timing assumptions.
does_not_approve: Changing the registered control or reserved years
approval.approval_effect: Approves the named research implementation, verification and capped performance batch only after checks pass; approval flags remain false until explicit owner response.
